key_insight: A coordinated paid-content network uses promotional UGC placements to gain visibility in generative-engine answers, exposing weaknesses in content-only defenses.
engineering_relevance: Defenses against coordinated GEO campaigns should incorporate account- and platform-level signals alongside content analysis.
method: Map one paid-content operation across three major Chinese UGC platforms.
Analyze account growth, cross-platform coordination, and evolving listicle content.
Evaluate network citations across nine generative engines and client mentions across eight.
evidence_signal: The study identified 1,985 associated accounts and 466,357 inferred promotional placements; network pages comprised 4.5%–20% of retrievable cited pages, while clients appeared in 52% of answers versus 68% for category leaders.
watch_item: Findings concern one network, and citation attribution varies with strictness; client mentions alone do not establish causal influence.
paper_title: GEOHunter: Mapping a Generative Engine Optimization Network in the Wild
